blocking smell "reflect-testlist-defect": reflection gate: T7 (AC1) and T38 (AC5) assert the home route `/` lists a `stock-row` for the filed SKU. The home stock table and `stock-row` seam belong to F1-S2 (IA: 'Home stock-by-location table (F1-S2)'), not built in S1, so these tests are unsatisfiable inside S1. Verify the stored row via the paired-branch DB or the API (GET/SELECT), or assert only S1 seams on /stock/new.; T5 and T34 are kind:component (jsdom Vitest harness) but their descriptions say 'to the real API' / 'when the real API returns 409'. A component test has no live backend. The IA and AC5 notes require a mocked 409 -> seam text at the component layer, with the real-API check left to the Playwright e2e (T36). Rewrite both descriptions to use a mocked fetch/response, and drop the 'randomUUID-suffixed sku' real-API premise from T34.
